private.title: Private event — approval required
private.intro: Before you continue, here's how tickets work for this event:
private.step1: You send your request for free: no card details are asked for and nothing is charged now.
private.step2: The venue team reviews your request (up to 48 h).
private.step3: If they accept, you get an email with a payment link. You have 24 h to complete it.
private.step4: If they decline or you don't pay in time, nothing happens: there was never a charge.
private.foot: We'll email you at every step. No need to call.
private.noticeBody: For now you're only sending a request: no card details are asked for and nothing is charged.

requestSent.title: Request sent!
requestSent.body: Nothing has been charged. The venue team will review your request and we'll email you.
requestSent.detail: If they approve it, you'll get an email with a payment link to complete your tickets.

resume.payableBody: This order is waiting for payment. You'll be taken to dLocal's secure page; once the payment is confirmed you'll get your tickets with the QR code by email.
resume.missingCode: This link is incomplete. Open the payment link exactly as it came in your email (it includes the code).
resume.awaitingBody: The venue hasn't decided yet. Nothing has been charged — we'll email you the decision.
resume.processingBody: It may take a few seconds. Don't pay again: we'll email your tickets as soon as it's confirmed.
resume.confirmedBody: Your tickets are already in your inbox, with the PDF and QR codes.
resume.deadTitle: This order is no longer available
resume.deadBody: The request was cancelled or expired, so this link no longer works. You can go back to the event and start again.
resume.notFound: We couldn't find this order. The link may be invalid or expired.
